concerns.text: T026 triggers piecewise regression if R² < 0.1, but T024 discards the joint model if VIF > 5. The task does not specify checking the R² of the *selected* univariate model (per Plan.md VIF Fallback Logic) against the 0.1 threshold. This creates a logic gap where the piecewise test (FR-014) may never trigger if the joint model is discarded, violating the spec's requirement to test non-linear models when the *effective* fit is poor.

T032a validates the dataset spans '(-01-01 to 2023-12-31)' but T011 only requires '≥10 years' of data. If the pipeline ingests data through 2025 (current date), T032a's hardcoded 2023 cutoff may fail or misalign with the Plan.md's fixed split (2010-2020/2021-2023). The task lacks an explicit `END_DATE` configuration to enforce the Plan.md's specific 2023 boundary, risking a silent drift from the required time-series split.

T067 requires calculating 'Minimum Detectable Effect Size' (MDES) and appending a 'Power Limitation' section if N < 30. However, the Spec (Assumptions) and Plan only mandate logging a warning and deferring claims. While T067 adds rigor, it introduces a new output key ('Power Limitation' section) not defined in the `contracts/metrics.schema.yaml` (T020/T028) or the Spec's Success Criteria. This risks a schema validation failure (FR-013) unless the schema is updated to include this new key.

T011b raises `DataWindowError` if data covers < 10 years. The Spec (FR-001) requires '≥10 years', but the Plan.md Summary implies the split is fixed to 2010-2023 (13 years). If the pipeline runs in 2024 and only 10 years are available (2014-2023), T011b passes, but T032 (fixed 2010-2020 split) will fail due to missing 2010-2013 data. The task does not enforce the *specific* 2010 start date required by the Plan.md's fixed split, only the duration.
